concepts.gloss_en: The strap(s) of tefillin, functioning as the encompassing lights of Malkhut/faith and as yirah (fear)

members.note: representative; strap of tefillin = yirah/malkhut, incl. plural רְצוּעוֹת
same referent — 'the strap' of tefillin = yirah, used in lm2:77 alongside רצועה; definite article is anaphoric (back-reference), not archetype-shifting

notes: Definite article here is a simple back-reference to the previously named strap, not an archetype distinction; both forms describe the strap of tefillin as yirah. Plural רְצוּעוֹת and singular are the same concrete concept.
